meta.title: Salmon Loss: Statistics on Loss and Mortality of Salmon and Rainbow Trout in the Sea Phase
meta.description: Explore interactive statistics on loss and mortality of salmon and rainbow trout in the sea phase in Norway

header.h1: Statistics on Loss and Mortality of Salmon and Rainbow Trout in the Sea Phase

tool_descriptions.monthly_mortality: Get monthly mortality (%) in the sea phase for salmon or rainbow trout, filtered by species, geographic level, area, year and month.
tool_descriptions.cumulative_mortality: Get cumulative yearly mortality (%) (mean), reported per month, for salmon or rainbow trout.
tool_descriptions.cohort_mortality: Get mortality (%) for completed production cycles (cohorts), per year and area.
tool_descriptions.monthly_losses: Get monthly loss figures (fish count): total, dead, discarded, escaped and other, for salmon or rainbow trout.
tool_descriptions.yearly_losses: Get yearly loss figures (fish count): total, dead, discarded, escaped and other, for salmon or rainbow trout.
tool_descriptions.list_regions: List available area names, grouped by geographic level (area/county/country). Species and geographic level are optional filters - omit them to see all. Use this when unsure of the correct area name before calling the other tools.
tool_descriptions.list_years: List which years have available data, per dataset/tool (e.g. 'monthly_mortality', 'yearly_losses'). Species and geographic level are optional filters - omit them to see coverage for every combination, since coverage can vary. Use this when the user asks which years/time period data exists for.

arg_descriptions.species: Fish species. 'salmon' = salmon, 'rainbowtrout' = rainbow trout. Default: 'salmon'.
arg_descriptions.geo_group: Geographic resolution: 'area' (production area), 'county' or 'country' (all of Norway). Default: 'area'.
arg_descriptions.region: Name of the area/region, must match the selected geo_group. Use the 'list_regions' tool if unsure of the correct name. Leave blank for all areas.
arg_descriptions.year: Year to filter on, e.g. 2023. Omit for all years.
arg_descriptions.month: Month number (1-12) to filter on. Omit for all months.
arg_descriptions.species_all: Fish species to filter on. 'salmon' = salmon, 'rainbowtrout' = rainbow trout. Omit to see all species.
arg_descriptions.geo_group_all: Geographic resolution to filter on: 'area' (production area), 'county' or 'country' (all of Norway). Omit to see all levels.

summaries.monthly_mortality: Monthly mortality (%) in the sea phase. q1/median/q3 are quartiles for the selected subset.
summaries.cumulative_mortality: Cumulative yearly mortality (%) (mean), reported per month.
summaries.cohort_mortality: Mortality (%) for completed production cycles (cohorts, at least 8 months), per year and area. q1/median/q3 are quartiles.
summaries.monthly_losses: Monthly loss figures (fish count): total (losses), dead, discarded, escaped and other.
summaries.yearly_losses: Yearly loss figures (fish count): total (losses), dead, discarded, escaped and other.
summaries.list_regions: Available area names, grouped by geographic level, for species='%s', geo_group='%s'.
summaries.list_years: Available years per tool/dataset, for species='%s', geo_group='%s'. Different tools may cover different year ranges.

messages.region_not_found: Could not find the area '%s'. Available areas for geo_group='%s': %s.
messages.year_not_found: No data found for year %s. Available years: %s.
